name: @wtfos/atproto-spine
description: App-agnostic AT Protocol spine primitives for wtfOS: PDS write client, PDS admin/provisioning client, config-driven record mapping + domain routing, relay firehose consumer, and on-demand TLS gate. Extracted and generalized from the TZAT (tz2at) relay; Tezos specifics removed.

wtfos.note: Currently consumed in-tree via the @wtfos/atproto-spine tsconfig path alias and resolves @atproto/api, ws, and zod from the root node_modules. On a true monorepo/workspace extraction, promote peerDependencies to dependencies and add a local install.
